messages.message: Technical Support Engineer on Google Cloud Platform (Apigee)
Provided enterprise-level technical support for enterprise customers using API management platforms built on Google Cloud Platform.
Acted as a customer-facing support engineer, handling priority-based tickets and ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
Reproduced customer-reported issues in test environments, maintained those reproductions until resolution, documented findings, and contributed to internal bug reports and documentation feedback.
Troubleshot issues related to API design, configuration, and runtime behavior within complex distributed architectures.
Investigated and resolved problems involving supporting GCP components such as Load Balancers, IAM, networking, logging, monitoring, API gateways (Apigee), and cluster configuration.
Collaborated with software engineers and sales to de-escalate cases, validate fixes, and improve product functionality and documentation.

I worked with Google Cloud infrastructure and services, including Kubernetes, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, Load Balancing, logging, monitoring, and Cloud Networking. The role also involved troubleshooting complex issues, finding root causes, and helping improve system stability.
